_how_to_read: usage_multiplier scales a resource's daily usage (0.9 = use 10% less). usage_offset adds or removes a fixed amount per day (negative = saves, positive = costs). add_backup moves that resource's backup reserve into the main supply.

ration_food.title: Ration food by 10%
ration_food.why: Smallest change that stretches food without stopping work.

use_backup_food.title: Open the backup food reserve
use_backup_food.why: Emergency reserve. Once it is used, there is no second safety net.

prioritize_greenhouse.title: Prioritize greenhouse production
prioritize_greenhouse.why: Grows ~0.6 kg of food per day but the grow lights cost ~4 kWh per day.

repair_water_recycler.title: Repair water recycling first
repair_water_recycler.why: A better recovery rate cuts net water use by about 20%.

use_backup_water.title: Open the backup water reserve
use_backup_water.why: Emergency reserve. Use only if recycling cannot be fixed in time.

repair_air_system.title: Repair air filtration first
repair_air_system.why: Cuts oxygen losses by about 15%, but the repair runs extra equipment (~2 kWh/day).

reduce_energy.title: Reduce nonessential energy use by 15%
reduce_energy.why: Dim non-work areas and pause low-priority experiments.

use_backup_energy.title: Switch to the backup battery bank
